issues.title: Provide Time Slider to review events in previous turn
issues.body:
Players will spend the morning planning what they want to happen.

The umpires will spend the afternoon deciding what actually happened.

The next morning, the players will see the new "state of the world", and want to review what happened.

All of that data is present in the "Planning" channel, but it's spread across different places.

I've just seen this demo:
https://skeate.dev/Leaflet.timeline/examples/earthquakes.html

It's a time-slider that moves through a series of timed GeoJSON features.  Each of our MessageInteraction messages contains a timed GeoSJON object.  We could just collate these into an array, and pass it to the `leaflet.timeline` control.

Ian can handle transforming the data, and getting it into the control, but he could do with support in integrating the control:
https://github.com/skeate/Leaflet.timeline

So, I guess the requirement is:
* [x] integrate control into Serge/components
* [x] introduce `showTimeSlider: boolean` and `timeSliderValues: GeoJSON.FeatureCollection` `useState` objects in `PlanningChannel`
* [x] add toggle button with `fa-history` icon to `PlanningChannel` to toggle the map in/out of `Replay` mode. Button toggles the value of `showTimeSlider`.
* [x] a new TimeSlider react component is produced, which takes a `events` prop as GeoJSON.FeatureCollection.
* [x] when `timeSlider` is true the timeline is shown at the bottom of the map
* [x] when `timeSlider` is true, a `useEffect` method will collate the GeoJSON.FeatureCollection data (I can do this :-) ), and store the array in `setTimeSliderValues`. The time-slider should now "wake-up", and we can move through the data.


Note: I was too excited, so I made a start here: https://github.com/serge-web/serge/pull/2135
